description: Codex variant of hooks.json. It differs in form — Codex ignores the command + args form, so every entry is a single command string — and in substance. Codex has no skill event (openai/codex#17132), so a run is opened by watching for the shell read of a SKILL.md under this plugin's root; and it drops updatedInput unless the hook also approves the call, so the marker is attached only on the four read-only Qase tools, where approving cannot mutate anything and never meets the destructive guards. Writes stay behind whatever approval the user has configured. The PowerShell twins are absent: on unix Codex reports the missing interpreter as a visible error beside a guard that worked. tests/test-hook-parity.sh keeps the guards in the two files identical.
